run.title: Tabular agent with a tuned constant learning rate
run.what_changed: Post-hoc constant-learning-rate run (EXPERIMENTS.md §8.3), registered 2026-11-05 before running. Learning rate 1/N(a) -> constant α = 3.2e-4, tuned on separate seeds (master seed 20261103, results/tuning/fa_tuning.json); everything else as baseline-v1: B = 20, 13M episodes, ε 1% at halfway, 20% grid, γ = 3, 5, 8, 10 seeds, master seed 20261016. Trained at commit bc311a3 (tag tabular-const).
